findings.title: Enter activation unexpectedly moves focus out of the tablist
source_anchors: index.html:589 — tab click handler invokes render(Number(tab.dataset.step), true)
findings.reproduction: Focus STEP 01, press ArrowDown, then Enter, then ArrowDown. Observed: ArrowDown initially selects and focuses tab-1 (2 / 4). Enter moves focus to scenario-panel. The following ArrowDown leaves selection at tab-1 / 2 / 4 instead of navigating tabs.
findings.impact: Tab selection, roving tabindex, and focus are consistent for arrow navigation, but native Enter/Space activation takes a different focus path. This interrupts conventional tablist keyboard navigation; Shift+Tab returns to the selected tab, so it is not a keyboard trap.
findings.recommendation: Keep focus on the selected tab when activating a tab. Reserve explicit panel focus transfer for Previous/Next controls.

findings.title: No-JavaScript disclosure incorrectly says controls are disabled
source_anchors: index.html:387 — noscript states that stage-navigation buttons are disabled
index.html:368-371 — authored tab buttons have no disabled attribute
index.html:390 — authored Previous/Next buttons have no disabled attribute
findings.reproduction: Disable JavaScript before opening/reloading the standalone HTML. The visible noscript message promises disabled stage navigation, but the authored controls remain enabled and have no working handlers.
findings.impact: The static first-step explanation remains readable, but the fallback presents enabled, inert controls. Static HTML parsing confirmed that none of the six buttons has a disabled attribute; a full JavaScript-disabled browser run was not performed.
findings.recommendation: Make the authored no-script control state match the disclosure, enabling controls during JavaScript initialization, or provide an honest noninteractive fallback.

verified.result: The sole innerHTML assignment at index.html:568-574 interpolates only the closed, hardcoded steps array and derived numeric labels. No URL, form, message, storage, or external-input source feeds it. The complete inline script contains no network or dynamic-code-execution API. Parsed HTML resources contain two embedded PNGs, no external script/link/frame/form/embed, and only fragment navigation links; CSS contains no external resource references.

All four tabs are native type=button elements with role=tab and aria-controls=scenario-panel. Each selected state has exactly one aria-selected=true and one tabIndex=0; panel aria-labelledby tracks it. Home, End, all four arrows, wraparound, and Shift+Tab return were exercised. Native ArrowDown/End/ArrowRight and Enter were exercised through browser key events; the complete six-key matrix was additionally checked with dispatched keydown events. The Enter focus issue is reported above.

Exercised 1→2→3→4→4 and 4→3→2→1→1. Previous is disabled only at 1/4; Next only at 4/4. Clicking a disabled boundary control leaves the step unchanged. Panel focus after these navigation buttons is retained intentionally. Full observed matrices: artifact://754 and artifact://771.

Loaded the actual standalone file in an isolated agent-browser session, enabled offline mode, reloaded, and observed navigator.onLine=false, initialized step 1/4, both decoded images complete, and an empty resource-timing list. Next-button interaction continued to work. Browser errors command returned no errors. Session was closed.

limitations: No edits, Git commands, formatters, linters, or project-wide suites were run. This is an artifact-scoped review, not a PR/CI merge-readiness review.
